6	import Mathlib
7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Genus
8	
9	/-! # The Jacobian of a smooth proper curve
10	
11	The Jacobian of a smooth, proper, geometrically irreducible curve over a field, equipped with
12	its structure as an abelian variety.
13	
14	## Status
15	
16	The Jacobian is defined uniformly as the underlying scheme of an Albanese witness
17	(`JacobianWitness`) for the curve `C`; the four protected instances on `Jacobian C` all
18	project from the witness directly.
19	
20	The construction is **uniform in the genus**: the witness is the Picard identity
21	component `Pic⁰_{C/k}` (`picardJacobianWitness`), an abelian variety of dimension
22	`genus C` built by the FGA route (`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.*` +
23	`AlgebraicJacobian.Albanese.*`). There is **no** genus `= 0` / genus `> 0` split: when
24	`genus C = 0` the tangent space `H¹(C, 𝒪_C)` is `0`-dimensional, so `Pic⁰_{C/k} = Spec k`
25	falls out automatically. The former separate `genusZeroWitness` lane (with its
26	`RigidityKbar` / cotangent-vanishing / Frobenius / `ℙ¹`-identification machinery) was a
27	pre-FGA local optimisation and has been removed.
28	
29	This file contains exactly ONE `sorry`-bodied mathematical declaration,
30	`picardJacobianWitness`, whose closure is the FGA construction of `Pic⁰_{C/k}` as an
31	abelian variety with its Albanese universal property.
32	
33	The file contains:
34	- `IsAlbanese`: the Albanese universal property for a pointed curve.
35	- `IsAlbanese.unique`: uniqueness of the Albanese object up to canonical isomorphism.
36	- `JacobianWitness`: a bundled candidate Albanese object together with the universal
37	  property uniformly over the choice of $k$-rational marked point.
38	- `picardJacobianWitness`: the Albanese witness `J = Pic⁰_{C/k}`, body `sorry`.
39	- `nonempty_jacobianWitness`: existence of an Albanese witness for every curve,
40	  delegating to `picardJacobianWitness`.
41	- `Jacobian` and its four protected instances, each obtained by projection from the
42	  Albanese witness.
43	
44	### Forbidden shortcut (sanity check)
45	
46	Defining `Jacobian C := 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k)))` *unconditionally* (the terminal object,
47	i.e. `Spec k`) compiles and discharges three of the four instances for free, but the
48	fourth instance `SmoothOfRelativeDimension (genus C) (𝟙_ _).hom` would force `genus C = 0`,
49	which is mathematically wrong for any curve of genus `≥ 1`. The terminal-object definition
50	is therefore forbidden when `genus C > 0`. The witness-based definition avoids this
51	issue: the witness's `J` is `Pic⁰_{C/k}`, which is `Spec k` exactly when `genus C = 0`
52	and the honest Albanese object otherwise.
53	-/
54	
55	set_option autoImplicit false
56	
57	universe u
58	
59	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory MonObj
60	
61	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
62	
63	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
64	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]
65	  [IsProper C.hom]
66	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
67	
68	/-- The Albanese universal property for a pointed smooth proper curve `(C, P)`.
69	An object `J` (with abelian-variety structure) is the Albanese of `(C, P)` if it
70	receives a universal pointed morphism `C ⟶ J` sending `P` to the identity. -/
71	def IsAlbanese (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) (P : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ C)
72	    (J : Over (Spec (.of k)))
73	    [GrpObj J] [IsProper J.hom] [Smooth J.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible J.hom] : Prop :=
74	  ∃ α : C ⟶ J, P ≫ α = η[J] ∧
75	    ∀ {A : Over (Spec (.of k))} [GrpObj A] [IsProper A.hom]
76	      [Smooth A.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible A.hom] (f : C ⟶ A) (_ : P ≫ f = η[A]),
77	      ∃! (g : J ⟶ A), f = α ≫ g
78	
79	namespace IsAlbanese
80	
81	noncomputable def ofCurve {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
82	    {P : 𝟙_ _ ⟶ C} {J : Over (Spec (.of k))} [GrpObj J] [IsProper J.hom] [Smooth J.hom]
83	    [GeometricallyIrreducible J.hom] (h : IsAlbanese C P J) : C ⟶ J :=
84	  Classical.choose h
85	
86	lemma comp_ofCurve {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
87	    {P : 𝟙_ _ ⟶ C} {J : Over (Spec (.of k))} [GrpObj J] [IsProper J.hom] [Smooth J.hom]
88	    [GeometricallyIrreducible J.hom] (h : IsAlbanese C P J) :
89	    P ≫ h.ofCurve = η[J] :=
90	  (Classical.choose_spec h).1
91	
92	lemma exists_unique_ofCurve_comp {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
93	    {P : 𝟙_ _ ⟶ C} {J : Over (Spec (.of k))} [GrpObj J] [IsProper J.hom] [Smooth J.hom]
94	    [GeometricallyIrreducible J.hom] (h : IsAlbanese C P J)
95	    {A : Over (Spec (.of k))} [GrpObj A] [IsProper A.hom] [Smooth A.hom]
96	    [GeometricallyIrreducible A.hom] (f : C ⟶ A) (hf : P ≫ f = η[A]) :
97	    ∃! (g : J ⟶ A), f = h.ofCurve ≫ g :=
98	  (Classical.choose_spec h).2 f hf
99	
100	/-- The Albanese object is unique up to a unique isomorphism compatible with the
101	universal morphisms. -/
102	theorem unique {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))} {P : 𝟙_ _ ⟶ C}
103	    {J₁ J₂ : Over (Spec (.of k))}
104	    [GrpObj J₁] [IsProper J₁.hom] [Smooth J₁.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible J₁.hom]
105	    [GrpObj J₂] [IsProper J₂.hom] [Smooth J₂.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible J₂.hom]
106	    (h₁ : IsAlbanese C P J₁) (h₂ : IsAlbanese C P J₂) :
107	    ∃! (e : J₁ ⟶ J₂), h₂.ofCurve = h₁.ofCurve ≫ e := by
108	  have ⟨g, hg_eq, hg_unique⟩ := h₁.exists_unique_ofCurve_comp h₂.ofCurve h₂.comp_ofCurve
109	  have ⟨h, hh_eq, hh_unique⟩ := h₂.exists_unique_ofCurve_comp h₁.ofCurve h₁.comp_ofCurve
110	  have ⟨g₁, hg₁_eq, hg₁_unique⟩ := h₁.exists_unique_ofCurve_comp h₁.ofCurve h₁.comp_ofCurve
111	  have g₁_eq_id : g₁ = 𝟙 J₁ := by
112	    refine (hg₁_unique (𝟙 J₁) ?_).symm
113	    simp
114	  have ggh_eq_g₁ : g ≫ h = g₁ := by
115	    refine hg₁_unique (g ≫ h) ?_
116	    change h₁.ofCurve = h₁.ofCurve ≫ (g ≫ h)
117	    rw [← Category.assoc, ← hg_eq, ← hh_eq]
118	  have hgh : g ≫ h = 𝟙 J₁ := by rw [ggh_eq_g₁, g₁_eq_id]
119	  have ⟨k₂, hk₂_eq, hk₂_unique⟩ := h₂.exists_unique_ofCurve_comp h₂.ofCurve h₂.comp_ofCurve
120	  have k₂_eq_id : k₂ = 𝟙 J₂ := by
121	    refine (hk₂_unique (𝟙 J₂) ?_).symm
122	    simp
123	  have hhg_eq_k₂ : h ≫ g = k₂ := by
124	    refine hk₂_unique (h ≫ g) ?_
125	    change h₂.ofCurve = h₂.ofCurve ≫ (h ≫ g)
126	    rw [← Category.assoc, ← hh_eq, ← hg_eq]
127	  have hhg : h ≫ g = 𝟙 J₂ := by rw [hhg_eq_k₂, k₂_eq_id]
128	  exact ⟨g, hg_eq, fun g' hg' => hg_unique g' hg'⟩
129	
130	end IsAlbanese
131	
132	/-- A bundled Albanese witness for the smooth proper geometrically irreducible curve
133	`C`: a candidate group scheme `J` (with proper, smooth, geometrically irreducible
134	structure, smooth of relative dimension `genus C`), and a proof that `J` satisfies
135	the Albanese universal property of Definition `IsAlbanese` for `C` *for every choice
136	of $k$-rational marked point* `P : 𝟙_ _ ⟶ C`.
137	
138	Mathematically, the underlying scheme `J` (and its group/proper/smooth/irreducible
139	structure) is intrinsic to `C`; only the universal morphism `C ⟶ J` depends on the
140	choice of marked point `P`. Encoding `isAlbaneseFor` as a `∀ P, IsAlbanese …` field
141	keeps the bundle independent of any specific pointing, which is what
142	`AbelJacobi.Jacobian.ofCurve P` needs in order to project the Albanese morphism for
143	an *arbitrary* input `P`.
144	
145	The smoothness witness is recorded at the specific relative dimension `genus C`,
146	which is the form required by `Jacobian.smoothOfRelativeDimension_genus`. -/
147	structure JacobianWitness (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
148	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] where
149	  /-- The candidate Albanese object. -/
150	  J : Over (Spec (.of k))
151	  /-- The group-scheme structure on `J`. -/
152	  grpObj : GrpObj J
153	  /-- `J` is proper over `k`. -/
154	  proper : IsProper J.hom
155	  /-- `J` is smooth over `k`. -/
156	  smooth : Smooth J.hom
157	  /-- `J` is geometrically irreducible over `k`. -/
158	  geomIrred : GeometricallyIrreducible J.hom
159	  /-- `J` is smooth of relative dimension `genus C` (so dim `J = genus C`). -/
160	  smoothGenus : SmoothOfRelativeDimension (genus C) J.hom
161	  /-- The Albanese universal-property data: for every choice of $k$-rational marked
162	  point `P : 𝟙_ _ ⟶ C`, the scheme `J` together with its group/proper/smooth/irreducible
163	  structure satisfies the Albanese universal property for the pointed curve `(C, P)`. -/
164	  isAlbaneseFor : ∀ (P : 𝟙_ _ ⟶ C), @IsAlbanese k _ C P J grpObj proper smooth geomIrred
165	
166	
167	/-- The Albanese witness for a smooth proper geometrically irreducible curve `C`,
168	constructed **uniformly in the genus** as the identity component `Pic⁰_{C/k}` of the
169	Picard scheme of `C`.
170	
171	By the FGA route (`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.*`), `Pic⁰_{C/k}` is representable
172	(`Scheme.PicScheme.representable`) and is an abelian variety of dimension `genus C`:
173	its tangent space at the identity is `H¹(C, 𝒪_C)` (`Scheme.Pic0.tangentSpaceIso`),
174	giving smoothness of relative dimension `genus C` (`Scheme.Pic0.smooth`), properness
175	(`Scheme.Pic0.proper`), and geometric irreducibility
176	(`Scheme.Pic0.geometricallyIrreducible`); the Albanese universal property is the
177	Abel–Jacobi factorisation of `AlgebraicJacobian.Albanese.AlbaneseUP`.
178	
179	The genus-`0` case is **not** special and needs no separate construction: when
180	`genus C = 0` the tangent space is `0`-dimensional, so `Pic⁰_{C/k} = Spec k`
181	automatically, and the universal property degenerates to the (then trivial) statement
182	that every pointed morphism `C ⟶ A` into an abelian variety is constant. The former
183	`genusZeroWitness` / `positiveGenusWitness` genus split — together with its bespoke
184	rigidity / cotangent-vanishing / Frobenius / `ℙ¹`-identification machinery — has been
185	removed in favour of this single uniform witness. -/
186	noncomputable def picardJacobianWitness (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
187	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] :
188	    JacobianWitness C :=
189	  sorry
190	
191	/-- Existence of an Albanese witness for every smooth proper geometrically irreducible
192	curve, uniformly in the genus via the Picard identity component `Pic⁰_{C/k}`
193	(`picardJacobianWitness`). This packages all five protected sorries (`Jacobian`,
194	`instGrpObj`, `smoothOfRelativeDimension_genus`, `instIsProper`,
195	`instGeometricallyIrreducible`) into a single existence statement, and records that the
196	Albanese property of the underlying scheme `J` is uniform over every choice of
197	`k`-rational marked point `P : 𝟙_ _ ⟶ C` (via the `isAlbaneseFor` field of
198	`JacobianWitness`). -/
199	theorem nonempty_jacobianWitness (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
200	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] :
201	    Nonempty (JacobianWitness C) :=
202	  ⟨picardJacobianWitness C⟩
203	
204	/-- A choice of Albanese witness for `C`, extracted via `Classical.choice`.
205	Used to define `Jacobian C` and to discharge each of the four protected instances
206	on it. -/
207	noncomputable def jacobianWitness (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
208	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] :
209	    JacobianWitness C :=
210	  Classical.choice (nonempty_jacobianWitness C)
211	
212	-- data
213	/-- The Jacobian of a smooth, proper curve over a field `k`.
214	
215	The Jacobian is the underlying scheme of an Albanese witness for `C` (see
216	`JacobianWitness` and `nonempty_jacobianWitness`); the existence of such a
217	witness (`picardJacobianWitness`, `J = Pic⁰_{C/k}`) is the single open
218	mathematical sorry, closed by the FGA construction. The genus-`0`
219	specialisation is implicit in the witness — a smooth proper geometrically
220	irreducible group scheme over `k` of relative dimension `0` is `Spec k` — so
221	no separate genus-`0` construction is needed. -/
222	noncomputable def Jacobian (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper C.hom]
223	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] :
224	    Over (Spec (.of k)) :=
225	  (jacobianWitness C).J
226	
227	namespace Jacobian
228	
229	/-! ## The Jacobian of `C` is an abelian variety. -/
230	
231	-- data
232	/-- The group scheme structure on the Jacobian of the curve `C`. -/
233	noncomputable instance instGrpObj : GrpObj (Jacobian C) := (jacobianWitness C).grpObj
234	
235	/-- The Jacobian of `C` is smooth of relative dimension `g` over `k`, where `g` is the
236	genus of `C`. -/
237	instance smoothOfRelativeDimension_genus : SmoothOfRelativeDimension (genus C) (Jacobian C).hom :=
238	  (jacobianWitness C).smoothGenus
239	
240	/-- The Jacobian of `C` is proper over `k`. -/
241	instance instIsProper : IsProper (Jacobian C).hom := (jacobianWitness C).proper
242	
243	/-- The Jacobian of `C` is geometrically irreducible over `k`. -/
244	instance instGeometricallyIrreducible : GeometricallyIrreducible (Jacobian C).hom :=
245	  (jacobianWitness C).geomIrred
246	
247	end Jacobian
248	
249	end AlgebraicGeometry
250

1	/-

6	import Mathlib
7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.IdentityComponent
8	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.TangentSpaceDualNumbers
9	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.TangentSpaceIdentitySection
10	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0TangentSpace
11	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0DualNumberCocycle
12	import AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.Adelic.GenusUnconditional
13	import AlgebraicJacobian.Genus
14	
15	/-!
16	# `Pic⁰_{C/k}` as an abelian variety (A.3.iii–vii)
17	
18	This file is the **iter-193 Pic0AbelianVariety** file-skeleton (NEW lane,
19	blueprint-doctor flagged orphan resolution for the iter-192 plan-phase chapter
20	`Picard_Pic0AbelianVariety.tex`). It packages the strategy phase A.3.iii–vi
21	substrate and the A.3.vii assembly into the load-bearing Route~A statement
22	`Pic⁰_{C/k}` is an abelian variety, the gate of `thm:nonempty_jacobianWitness`
23	for `g(C) ≥ 1` curves.
24	
25	The chapter consumes the abstract identity-component substrate set up in
26	`Picard/IdentityComponent.lean` (`Pic⁰_{C/k}` as a clopen subgroup scheme of
27	finite type, geometrically irreducible, formation commuting with base change)
28	and adds the curve-specific input: the tangent-space isomorphism
29	`T₀ Pic⁰_{C/k} ≅ H¹(C, 𝒪_C)`, the resulting smoothness of dimension `g` at
30	the origin (hence everywhere by translation), properness inherited from the
31	projectivity of `Pic⁰_{C/k}` for `C/k` geometrically normal, and the assembly
32	into an abelian variety in the sense of Milne §I.1.
33	
34	## Status (run 0015, T16 W12-tangent session; previously run 0008 T5)
35	
36	Proved sorry-free in this file: `grpObj` (the `GrpObj (Pic0Scheme C)`
37	structure, via `IdentityComponent.isSubgroupHomomorphism` +
38	`PicScheme.groupSchemeStructure`), `tangentSpaceCotangentDual`,
39	`geometricallyIrreducible` (specialisation of the sibling's
40	`isFiniteTypeGeometricallyIrreducible`, whose QC∧GeomIrred conjuncts were
41	closed in run 0009 — `IdentityComponent.lean`, Kleiman §5 Lem.~`lem:agps`(3)),
42	the `isAbelianVariety` assembly, and the moved
43	`Pic0Scheme.isAbelianVariety` (blueprint pin `thm:pic_zero_is_abelian_variety`).
44	
45	Remaining `sorry` bodies: `finrank_cotangentSpaceDual_eq_finrank_h1Cok` —
46	the wave-5 W12-cocycle reduced core of the Kleiman §5 Thm 5.11 dimension
47	identity: `dim_{κ(e)} Dual(m_e/m_e²) = dim_k Ȟ¹(S, 𝒪_C)` against the concrete
48	two-chart Čech cokernel of any 2-affine cover `S`. The formerly-sorried
49	dimension identity `finrank_cotangentSpace_eq_finrank_hModuleOne` (which
50	`tangentSpaceIso` consumes, via the run-0015
51	`nonempty_cotangentSpaceAddEquiv_of_finrank_eq` reduction of
52	`Picard/Pic0TangentSpace.lean`) is now PROVED from the reduced core by
53	`Subspace.dual_finrank_eq` + the genus lane's cover
54	(`Adelic.exists_affineCoverMVSquare_module_finite_H1Cok`) + the gate-free
55	comparison `AffineCoverMVSquare.hModuleOneEquivH1Cok_curve`. Wave-4
56	W12-finrank closed the **representability leg**
57	(`pointedDualNumberPoints_equiv_relPicKernel`,
58	`cotangentSpaceDual_equiv_relPicKernel` below, set-level both directions) and
59	landed the Mumford `ε ↦ aε` scaling substrate; wave-5 landed the **two-chart
60	Čech unit-cocycle engine** (`DualNumber.truncExpCechKernelAddEquiv`,
61	`Picard/Pic0DualNumberCocycle.lean` §6 — the algebra layer of the cocycle
62	leg, with Mumford-scaling equivariance). The remaining content of the core is
63	the geometric chart-triviality/section-identification substrate plus the
64	`k`-(semi)linearity bookkeeping — and `smooth`, `proper`.
65	
66	The 5 blueprint-pinned declarations are:
67	
68	1. `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Pic0.tangentSpaceIso` (theorem, A.3.iii) — the
69	   canonical isomorphism `T₀ Pic⁰_{C/k} ≅ H¹(C, 𝒪_C)` (Kleiman §5
70	   Thm.~`thm:tgtsp`). Packaged as an `AddEquiv` between the cotangent space
71	   `m_e/m_e²` at a `k`-rational identity-section point `e` and the project's
72	   first-cohomology `k`-module `Scheme.HModule k (Scheme.toModuleKSheaf C) 1`
73	   (from `Genus.lean`). The `k`-module structure on the cotangent space at a
74	   `k`-rational point is supplied as part of the existential bundle.
75	2. `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Pic0.smooth` (theorem, A.3.iv) — `Pic⁰_{C/k}` is
76	   `Smooth` over `k`. Kleiman §5 Cor.~`cor:sm` + Cor.~`cor:ch0`
77	   (characteristic-zero) + Ex.~`ex:jac` (curve case).
78	3. `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Pic0.proper` (theorem, A.3.v) — `Pic⁰_{C/k}` is
79	   `IsProper` over `k`. Kleiman §5 Thm.~`th:qpp&p` (projectivity upgrade for
80	   geometrically normal `C/k`).
81	4. `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Pic0.geometricallyIrreducible` (theorem, A.3.vi)
82	   — `Pic⁰_{C/k}` is `GeometricallyIrreducible` over `k`. Specialisation of
83	   `IdentityComponent.isFiniteTypeGeometricallyIrreducible` (sibling) to
84	   `G = PicScheme C`. Kleiman §5 Prp.~`prp:pic0`.
85	5. `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Pic0.isAbelianVariety` (theorem, A.3.vii) —
86	   `Pic⁰_{C/k}` is an abelian variety: `IsProper ∧ Smooth ∧
87	   GeometricallyIrreducible ∧ Nonempty (GrpObj _)`. Milne §I.1, p.~8
88	   (defining axioms) + Kleiman §5 Rmk.~`rmk:Jac`. Load-bearing A.3.vii gate
89	   of Route~A.
90	
91	## Note on type expressivity
92	
93	Following the project rule "Never weaken the type to dodge the proof", each
94	pinned declaration carries a substantive, non-tautological type:
95	
96	- `tangentSpaceIso C` — existentially quantifies over a `k`-rational
97	  identity-section point `e : Spec k ⟶ (Pic0Scheme C).left` and a `k`-module
98	  structure on the cotangent space `m_e/m_e²` (the `k`-module structure
99	  arising via the `k`-algebra structure on the stalk at a `k`-rational point;
100	  for the file-skeleton this Module instance is bundled as part of the Σ').
101	  Bundles an `AddEquiv` between the cotangent space and the
102	  `H¹(C, 𝒪_C)`-as-`k`-module. The body is iter-194+ work.
103	- `smooth C`, `proper C`, `geometricallyIrreducible C` — genuine `Prop`-valued
104	  statements on the structural morphism `(Pic0Scheme C).hom : Pic⁰_{C/k} ⟶
105	  Spec k`, not tautological.
106	- `isAbelianVariety C` — assembles the conjunction of the four
107	  abelian-variety properties (proper, smooth, geometrically irreducible,
108	  group-object structure); not vacuous because each conjunct is a genuine
109	  property/structure on the (typed-sorry) `Pic0Scheme C`.
110	
111	## Coordination with `Pic0Scheme`
112	
113	The underlying `k`-scheme `Pic⁰_{C/k}` is supplied by
114	`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Pic0Scheme C` from sibling
115	`Picard/IdentityComponent.lean` (`def:pic_zero_subscheme` in the blueprint).
116	We do not redefine the underlying scheme here; the `Pic0` namespace below
117	collects the curve-specific abelian-variety facts about `Pic0Scheme C`.
118	
119	## References
120	
121	Blueprint: `blueprint/src/chapters/Picard_Pic0AbelianVariety.tex`
122	(735 LOC, 5 pins). Sources:
123	- Kleiman, "The Picard scheme", §5, Thm.~`thm:tgtsp` (tangent space),
124	  Cor.~`cor:sm` + Cor.~`cor:ch0` (smoothness), Thm.~`th:qpp&p`
125	  (quasi-projectivity/projectivity), Prp.~`prp:pic0` (irreducibility),
126	  Rmk.~`rmk:Jac` (assembly to abelian scheme); arXiv:math/0504020.
127	- Milne, "Abelian Varieties" (course notes, 2008), §I.1, p.~8
128	  (definition of abelian variety) + Rmk. III.1.4(e) (dimension equals genus).
129	-/
130

132	
133	universe u
134	
135	open CategoryTheory Limits

9	/-!
10	# The Abel-Jacobi map
11	
12	The Abel-Jacobi map from a smooth, proper curve to its Jacobian, and the universal property
13	of the Jacobian as the Albanese variety.
14	
15	Since `Jacobian C` is by definition `(jacobianWitness C).J`, every declaration below is a
16	projection of the Albanese universal property carried by the witness field
17	`(jacobianWitness C).isAlbaneseFor P : IsAlbanese C P (jacobianWitness C).J`.
18	
19	## Main results
20	
21	* `Jacobian.ofCurve`: the Abel-Jacobi map `C ⟶ Jacobian C` attached to a `k`-rational point
22	  `P` of `C`.
23	* `Jacobian.comp_ofCurve`: the Abel-Jacobi map sends `P` to the neutral element of
24	  `Jacobian C`.
25	* `Jacobian.exists_unique_ofCurve_comp`: a morphism `f : C ⟶ A` to an abelian variety with
26	  `P ≫ f = η[A]` factors uniquely through the Abel-Jacobi map.
27	
28	## Remaining obligations
29	
30	The genus-0 rigidity input (classical rigidity `Hom(ℙ¹, A) = A(k)`) is not proved here: it is
31	part of the existence claim `nonempty_jacobianWitness` in `AlgebraicJacobian.Jacobian`, which is
32	still open.  The `isAlbaneseFor` field of a witness must verify the Albanese property for
33	genus-0 curves too, which is exactly that rigidity content.
34	
35	## References
36	
37	Source: [Mumford], *Abelian Varieties*, §4 (rigidity).
38	-/
39	
40	set_option autoImplicit false
41	
42	universe u
43	
44	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory MonObj
45	
46	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
47	
48	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
49	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]
50	  [IsProper C.hom]
51	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
52	
53	namespace Jacobian
54	
55	variable {C} in
56	-- data
57	/-- The Abel-Jacobi map from a smooth, proper curve to its Jacobian associated
58	to a `k`-rational point of `C`. Projects the Albanese universal morphism carried
59	by the witness `(jacobianWitness C).isAlbaneseFor P`. -/
60	noncomputable def ofCurve (P : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ C) : C ⟶ Jacobian C := by
61	  letI := (jacobianWitness C).grpObj
62	  letI := (jacobianWitness C).proper
63	  letI := (jacobianWitness C).smooth
64	  letI := (jacobianWitness C).geomIrred
65	  exact ((jacobianWitness C).isAlbaneseFor P).ofCurve
66	
67	variable {C} in
68	/-- The Abel-Jacobi map sends the `k`-rational point `P` to `0`, where `0` (denoted by `η` below) is
69	the neutral element of the group scheme `Jacobian C`. Projects the pointed-property
70	of the Albanese witness `(jacobianWitness C).isAlbaneseFor P`. -/
71	lemma comp_ofCurve (P : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ C) :
72	    P ≫ ofCurve P = η[Jacobian C] := by
73	  letI := (jacobianWitness C).grpObj
74	  letI := (jacobianWitness C).proper
75	  letI := (jacobianWitness C).smooth
76	  letI := (jacobianWitness C).geomIrred
77	  exact ((jacobianWitness C).isAlbaneseFor P).comp_ofCurve
78	
79	variable {C} in
80	/--
81	The universal property of the Jacobian variety: For any abelian variety `A`,
82	any morphism `f : C ⟶ A` such that `f(P) = 0` factors uniquely through the
83	Jacobian of `C`.
84	In other words, `Jacobian C` is the Albanese variety of `C`.
85	
86	The existence-and-uniqueness data is projected unconditionally from the witness
87	`(jacobianWitness C).isAlbaneseFor P`. The genus-0 rigidity content (`Hom(ℙ¹, A) = A(k)`,
88	Mumford §4) is absorbed into the deferred existence claim `nonempty_jacobianWitness`,
89	since the witness must verify the Albanese property for genus-0 curves too.
90	-/
91	theorem exists_unique_ofCurve_comp (P : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ C)
92	    {A : Over (Spec (.of k))} [Smooth A.hom] [IsProper A.hom] [GrpObj A]
93	    [GeometricallyIrreducible A.hom] (f : C ⟶ A) (hf : P ≫ f = η[A]) :
94	    ∃! (g : Jacobian C ⟶ A), f = ofCurve P ≫ g := by
95	  letI := (jacobianWitness C).grpObj
96	  letI := (jacobianWitness C).proper
97	  letI := (jacobianWitness C).smooth
98	  letI := (jacobianWitness C).geomIrred
99	  exact ((jacobianWitness C).isAlbaneseFor P).exists_unique_ofCurve_comp f hf
100	
101	end Jacobian
102	
103	end AlgebraicGeometry
